paragraphs: [Kiddushin 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.40b.8) relates that R' Tarfon and the elders were reclining in the upper room of Nitzah’s house in Lod.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives the upper room of the house of Nitzah in Lod as the setting for the debate about the relative importance of study and action.

Nitzah is the retained conventional transliteration of supplied נתזה, without independently fixing vowels or identity from a familiar Talmudic form. Upper room, house, reclining and Lod all remain. The elders is a common designation rather than an added formal body; Tarfon’s abbreviated title remains R'.
